claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Midodrine is a prodrug of the alpha-1 adrenergic agonist desglymidodrine; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since adrenergic receptor agonism does not drive cancer cell killing and no cytotoxic off-target is evident.
